agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, October 18, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Pro Tem Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on September 20, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
City of Lomita
City Council Agenda
Item #7h
i.
August 2016 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Consideration of resolutions relative to compensation and benefits for City Employees
Res. 2016-43 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Lomita and the Administrative and Field Services Units of the Lomita City Employees Association (LCEA).
ACTION: Adopt a resolution approving the attached MOUs with the Administrative and Field Service Units of the LCEA providing for a two-year agreement.
ACTION: Replace the Accounting Manager position with a new Senior Accountant classification and assign Salary Schedule No. 78, and approve the Senior Accountant class specification
Res. 2016-44 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving a Compensation Plan for Nonrepresented Employees for Fiscal Years 2016-17 and 2017-18 and Rescinding Resolution No. 2016-30.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution approving a Compensation Plan for the Non-Represented Employees.
Res. 2016-45 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, reaffirming employer paid member contributions under the California Public Employees Retirement System.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution amending the Employer Paid Member Contribution (EPMC) under the California Public Employees Retirement System. This action would reduce the City's contribution of the normal employee contribution for (Tier 1 employees) as follows:
a.
Effective July 1, 2016 from 1% to 0.5%
b.
Effective the first full pay period after July 1, 2017, from 0.5% to 0%;
Res. 2016-46 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita establishing a compensation plan for employees for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 20116 and ending June 30, 2017.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution amending the salary schedule for full-time employees for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2016 and ending June 30, 2017
Ord. No. 481 - An ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Code Amendment 2016-02 an amendment to Section 2-14.5.01 of the Lomita Municipal Code to change the recognized City holidays initiated by the City of Lomita. (First Reading)
ACTION: After the City Attorney reads the title, approve the first reading of an Ordinance amendment relative to Section 2-14.5.01 (City Holidays); and
Res. 2016-47 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving a list of recognized city holidays.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution establishing a list of recognized city holidays.
Item #7j
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION OF CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS DURING THE HOLIDAYS
9.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, November 1, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
